funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; must have a confirmed publisher and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles related to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; tiered amounts up to £3,000, £8,000, or £20,000 for postdoctoral level; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding to support research travel, research time, and related costs for projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or starting a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides a fixed £5,000 to support students beginning or continuing postgraduate study in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching 18th‑19th century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Fixed £2,000 grant to support travel and research on historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) at a UK institution, start between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding (£32,000) for one‑year (or split over two years part‑time) master's study in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a doctorate at a UK university, start between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees may differ).
opportunities.summary: Full doctoral funding (£96,000 total, £32,000 per year for three years) covering fees and living costs in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral level or equivalent individuals seeking to undertake a major research project in British art.
opportunities.summary: Provides £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years to support an in‑depth research project reshaping understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre‑doctoral to senior level.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium for research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
